newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pesticide firm ups 95/96 profit,sale.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pesticide firm ups 95/96 profit,sale.

text.p: Kafr el-Zayat Pesticides and Chemicals raised net distributable profits for financial 1995/96 to 6.85 million pounds ($2.80 million) from 4.85 million in 1994/95, results published on Saturday showed.
The financial years end on June 30.
The results showed that the privatised firm would distribute a 3.4 pound dividend for each of its 1.2 million shares. They did not provide comparative figures.
The state offered 40 percent of the firm to private investors earlier this year but increased the number of shares on offer due to overwhelming demand.
Individual investors hold a 65 percent in Kafr el-Zayat, its workers own 10 percent and the government holds the remaining 25 percent.
Pre-tax profits were also higher at 9.53 million in 95/96 compared to 6.63 million in the previous year, the results showed. Net sales rose to 85.61 million from 72.75 million in 94/95.
Company results made available earlier this year said net after-tax profits were 7.635 million pounds in 95/96, compared to 5.141 million a year earlier.
